description: Search the public Busymate DevTools documentation (setup and how-to guides for iPhone/iPad, Android, Mac/Windows/Linux browsers and desktop apps, the dashboard, proxy, bmc CLI, MCP and API) and return the best-matching pages with a snippet and their https://docs.busymate.dev URL. Pass a natural-language question or keywords. Read a full page with read_docs_page and cite its url. Public read; no sign-in or account data.

limit.description: How many pages to return (1-25). Defaults to 6.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "how do I set up my iPhone".

name: search_docs
title: Search Docs
